# mcp-slim (v0.6.0)
> Zero-Dependency MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 Stdio Proxy for Context Compression (-48.8% to -98.7% tokens), Cross-LLM `$defs/$ref` Inlining, Real-Time Secret Redaction (~0.93 ms p50), and Cumulative Cost Telemetry.

- Repository: https://github.com/SalyyS1/mcp-slim
- Live Interactive Playground: https://salyys1.github.io/mcp-slim/
- Author: SalyyS1 (https://github.com/SalyyS1)
- License: MIT
- Zero-Install (uvx): `uvx --from git+https://github.com/SalyyS1/mcp-slim mcp-slim --benchmark`
- Zero-Install (npx): `npx -y github:SalyyS1/mcp-slim --benchmark`
- Install (pip): `pip install git+https://github.com/SalyyS1/mcp-slim.git`
- Wrap Config: `mcp-slim wrap -i ~/.cursor/mcp.json`
- View Savings Ledger: `mcp-slim stats`
- GitHub Action: `uses: SalyyS1/mcp-slim@main`
- Companion Project: [loraspectra](https://github.com/SalyyS1/loraspectra) — Spectral SVD Auditor, Dynamic Rank Compressor & Orthogonal Merger for `.safetensors` LoRA Adapters.
